newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 30.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 30.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- A spate of bombings in Budapest continued on Thursday. The police have taken two suspects of a previous bombing into custody, but who commissioned them is still unknown.

- The Parliament's Constitutional Committee proposed that the conflict of interest bill should be passed in its current form, although President Arpad Goncz had sent the bill back to the Parliament for reconsideration.
- A committee is expected to meet on Friday to discuss whether the controversial social security regulation should be modified still this year.
- Prime Minister Gyula Horn is paying an official visit to the Netherlands to win the support of the country for Hungary's efforst to join the European Union.
- Some 30,000 in ten counties have fallen ill with the flu and 10 died in the epidemic, but the situation have not worsened recently.
